suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific biliary complication. Apply only to documented gallstone/cholelithiasis or biliary gallbladder disease with separately diagnosed acute pancreatitis attributable to a biliary etiology. Do not generalize to every gallbladder disorder. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Cholecystitis / Gallbladder Disease matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Pancreatitis with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply only to documented gallstone/cholelithiasis or biliary gallbladder disease with separately diagnosed acute pancreatitis attributable to a biliary etiology. Do not generalize to every gallbladder disorder.
